[SWS_DM_00491] Realisation of
UDS
service 0x86 ResponseOnEvent
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04160
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall implement the diagnostic service 0x86
ResponseOnEvent according to ISO 14229-1:2020 [1].
The implementation rules mentioned in [1], chapter 10.9.1 Service description shall be
adhered to.
⌋
